question: Should Telegram suppress all system-marked and compaction-notice payloads, or should this PR preserve the current `notifyUser` and command-reply delivery contracts?
rationale: The diff intentionally changes documented config-controlled message delivery and raw system-prefix handling, which is a product policy boundary rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contracts
options.body: Require the PR to keep `notifyUser` compaction notices and visible command/status replies deliverable while narrowing any suppression to a typed unwanted-notice class.

options.title: Approve A New Telegram Suppression Policy
options.body: Accept broad Telegram suppression only with an explicit docs/config policy update and upgrade proof showing existing users are not surprised by missing notices.

options.title: Pause Or Close Until Context Exists
options.body: Hold the branch until a concrete issue or maintainer-sponsored policy explains which system notices should be hidden and why.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contracts
recommendation.body: Require the PR to keep `notifyUser` compaction notices and visible command/status replies deliverable while narrowing any suppression to a typed unwanted-notice class.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is tied to the original notifyUser contract review and is the best available owner signal for the product boundary choice.
